verdict.rationale: Paychex documents a REST/OAuth 2.0 developer API for integrations: syncing an external HR system, maintaining worker data, check creation and recurring deductions. Nothing in the evidence shows a white-label or embedded payroll offering that partners can surface inside their own product under their own brand. The integration API is an adjacent capability for connecting to Paychex, not embedded payroll, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed white-label payroll into my own product through a partner API
